what_happened.line: The committee voted unanimously by roll call to reorganize, with Tim as chair and Jerry as clerk; the vice chair seat stayed open.
Members questioned the consultant's survey and outreach work, and one asked for a memo comparing the contract's deliverables with what was delivered.
A member noted the statement of work lists up to a set number of meetings, fewer have been held, and the contract ended in January.
Members agreed to ask other boards and commissions to send one representative each, with the town office to notify them.
The chair will ask the planning board chair to attend the next meeting and will seek a check-in with the consultant, who was absent.

why_it_matters: The master plan guides future zoning, housing and facilities decisions, and this meeting shows the committee has met rarely since May and has not yet established whether the plan is finished.
Whether the consultant's contract was fully used, and what was delivered under it, is still undetermined; the answer bears on whether more town money is needed to complete the plan.
